decisions.decision: Review cycle 1 (4 findings): site-header.tsx removed `hidden sm:block` from the search trigger and re-anchored the Popover to the whole action-icon cluster (`w-[min(360px,calc(100vw-2rem))]`) so it never overflows at 375px; templates-teaser.tsx grid fixed to `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`; occasions-section.tsx gained a <640px horizontal snap-scroll row; how-it-works-section.tsx gained a <640px vertical dashed connector and moved both decorative connectors out of the `<ol>` (fixing a pre-existing non-`<li>`-child defect); final-cta.tsx dropped its non-prototype bordered card for the prototype's own full-width warm-cream composition/copy/CTAs; custom-order-banner.tsx now renders both prototype CTAs (the second as the disabled/'Sắp ra mắt' convention already used elsewhere for that same out-of-scope destination); built ai/tasks/MEMORIES-0009/evidence/fidelity-matrix.json (6 entries, full-page CDP captures + geometry.log) since it did not previously exist. 4 new regression tests added (home-page.spec.tsx x3, site-header.spec.tsx x1).
decisions.reason: Each item maps 1:1 to one of review cycle 1's 4 blocking findings (mobile search unreachable at 375px; Templates/Occasions/HowItWorks/FinalCta diverging from the prototype's responsive composition; CustomOrderBanner missing its second CTA; no reproducible fidelity evidence) — see acceptance_criteria review:1:1..review:1:4 for full verification detail.

decisions.decision: Review cycle 2 (review:2:1): recaptured only the 3 default-state fidelity screenshot pairs with CDP `Emulation.setEmulatedMedia(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)`, an evidence-only fix (no source/test change).
decisions.reason: Both the prototype (index.html:850-854) and `Reveal` already treat reduced-motion as an immediate-visible fallback for their IntersectionObserver-driven scroll-reveal, which otherwise never fires for below-fold content in a non-scrolling capture — so this is a same-viewport, no-scroll, deterministic capture, not a different state. Search-open entries were untouched (unaffected, geometry-based not pixel-based).

decisions.decision: Review cycle 3 (3 findings): curated an explicit `HOME_FEATURED_TEMPLATES` array (lib/mock/card-templates.ts, appended so editor-view.tsx's unrelated `STARTER_TEMPLATES` slice is unaffected) and a fixed, locked-order `STYLE_FILTERS`, replacing a wrong `CARD_TEMPLATES.slice(0,6)` derivation; added optional `CardTemplate.price` + a `priceLabel()` helper rendering VND text when set; rewrote home-page.spec.tsx's filter/price tests to assert the exact locked contract (review:3:1). Killed a stale leftover `next-server` and rewrote the capture script to scroll the full document, cycle every carousel dot, and await per-image completion before each screenshot, fixing blank below-fold Gifts/Testimonials photos caused by `next/image` lazy-loading never firing in a non-scrolling capture; republished the runtime fidelity mirror to match (review:3:2). Changed Popover's outside-mousedown handler to call `event.preventDefault()` before dismissing (confirmed via user-event's `system/pointer/mouse.js` that this suppresses default focus-on-mousedown without blocking the outside target's own click action), then rewrote the outside-click test to drive a real `userEvent.click()` on the header's logo link instead of `fireEvent.mouseDown(document.body)` (review:3:3).
decisions.reason: Each item maps 1:1 to one of review cycle 3's 3 blocking findings — see acceptance_criteria review:3:1..review:3:3 for full verification detail (test counts, exact filter/price assertions, image-completeness counts).

(5:2) added durable, dependency-free evidence/scripts/{capture-fidelity.mjs,compare-fidelity.py,README.md}, replacing every prior cycle's uncommitted /tmp capture/compare script. (5:3) regenerated provenance.json and republished summary freshness tags as explicit `[tag: value]` markers. (6:1) the review:5:1 CTA was unconditionally opacity-0/hover-only, omitting the prototype's max-width:1024px default-visible override; fixed to default-visible with hidden/hover-reveal behind Tailwind's `lg:` variant (later corrected further by review:7:1). decisions.reason: Each item maps 1:1 to one of review cycles 5-6's 5 blocking findings — see acceptance_criteria review:5:1..review:6:2 for full verification detail (test names, exact pixel/style assertions, re-derived numbers).

decisions.decision: Review cycle 7 (2 findings, review:7:1/7:2): (1) template-card.tsx's variant='home' use-template CTA hidden/reveal treatment was gated behind Tailwind's default `lg:` variant (min-width:1024px), which incorrectly hid the CTA at exactly 1024px even though the locked prototype's `.use-template` override keeps it visible through max-width:1024px inclusive; changed the boundary to an explicit `min-[1025px]:` arbitrary variant and paired opacity with `pointer-events-none`/`pointer-events-auto` so the hidden desktop state can never be an invisible clickable hit target. (2) capture-fidelity.mjs's search-open geometry check never recorded or compared `window.scrollY` and always opened search from a fresh top-of-page navigation, so it could not detect a scroll-position regression; added scrollY to readHeaderGeometry, scroll to a deterministic non-zero position before opening search, and exercise+measure all three dismissal paths (Escape, outside click, close button), failing the capture if scrollY drifts at any point. Also added a captureCtaBoundary check with real-browser evidence at 1024px/1025px.
decisions.reason: Maps 1:1 to fix-request-review-007's 2 major findings — see acceptance_criteria review:7:1/review:7:2 for full verification detail (test/geometry-log evidence, exact pixel/style assertions).

decisions.decision: Review cycle 8 (review:8:1): fixed capture-fidelity.mjs's close-button dismissal, which selected by `button.textContent` and so never matched the real icon-only close IconButton (aria-label only, no text node) — the click was a silent no-op and the recorded 'after-close-button-close' geometry was actually still the open state. Now selects `#site-header-search-popover [aria-label="Đóng tìm kiếm"]` (accessible name, scoped to the popover), wraps every open/dismiss selector script in a `runRequiredAction()` helper that throws if nothing matches, and adds `assertDialogState()` (checking DOM presence of the popover by id, since it unmounts entirely on close) before-open and after every open/dismiss step across all 3 dismissal paths at all 3 viewports — throwing before any geometry read or artifact write on a mismatch. Regenerated all fidelity screenshots, geometry.log (now shows explicit `closed=true` per dismissal path) and the fidelity matrix against a fresh build/server/browser.
decisions.reason: Maps 1:1 to fix-request-review-008's 1 blocking finding — see acceptance_criteria review:8:1 for full verification detail. Evidence/handoff-only correction per the fix request's scope: no implementation source or test file was modified.

The prior evidence-only target (the header logo link) was rejected for this upgrade after a debug script showed its own click resets scrollY to 0 via Next.js Link's scroll-to-top-on-navigate behavior, even for a same-URL click — an unrelated side effect that would have contaminated the scroll-preservation assertion. Republished fidelity-matrix.json from a fresh capture run: corrected `generated_at`/method_notes (previously dated to review cycle 6), replaced 2 dead artifact references to screenshots deleted by review:7:1 with the current cta-boundary-*.png files, and rewrote every search-open entry to describe the scrollY/dialog-DOM-presence methodology actually used (previously described only headerHeight/headerBottom/mainTop/scrollWidth).

Documenting the current, verified state so future slices know these primitives exist and how to reuse Popover outside a menu context.
knowledge_updates.content:
## Cập nhật (MEMORIES-0009): Dialog/Drawer/Popover đã tồn tại, không chỉ Toast

Dòng "Drawer/modal/toast conventions" ở trên ("mới chỉ có Toast ... Chưa có drawer/modal nào được triển khai") đã lỗi thời. `packages/ui/src/components` hiện có cả bốn: `Toast`, `Dialog` (modal căn giữa, portal `document.body`, focus-trap, khóa scroll), `Drawer` (panel trượt cạnh, portal `document.body`, khóa scroll) và `Popover` (surface neo tuyệt đối `absolute` vào phần tử cha `position: relative` gần nhất — KHÔNG portal). Cả `Dialog`/`Drawer`/`Popover` dùng chung hook `packages/ui/src/hooks/use-dismissable-layer.ts` (`useDismissableLayer`) để: focus-trap Tab bên trong, đóng bằng Escape, và trả focus về phần tử đã mở layer khi đóng.

`Popover` (mở rộng bởi MEMORIES-0009) nhận thêm các prop tùy chọn sau, mặc định giữ nguyên hành vi cũ cho mọi call site hiện có:
- `role?: 'menu' | 'dialog'` (mặc định `'menu'`) — dùng `'dialog'` khi nội dung là form/control tuỳ ý (không phải danh sách `<PopoverItem>` menuitem).
- `lockScroll?: boolean` (mặc định `true`, giống `Dialog`/`Drawer`) — đặt `false` cho surface nhỏ không được khóa cuộn trang nền (vd. overlay tìm kiếm neo trên header).
- `id?: string` — để một trigger button trỏ `aria-controls` vào đúng surface.

Lưu ý bổ sung (review cycle 1): khi anchor wrapper của `Popover` chỉ bọc riêng trigger thay vì cả cụm action-icon chứa nó, surface căn `align="end"` có thể tràn ra ngoài viewport ở màn hình hẹp nếu còn control khác nằm bên phải trigger trong cùng hàng — hãy đặt `Popover` bên trong cụm `relative` bao ngoài cùng (không phải wrapper riêng của trigger) khi hàng chứa nhiều icon. Ví dụ: `apps/public-web/components/site-header.tsx`'s search overlay dùng `<Popover id={...} role="dialog" lockScroll={false} anchorRef={...} ...>` là con cuối cùng của `<div className="relative ml-auto flex items-center gap-0.5">` bọc toàn bộ cụm icon (search/heart/user/cart/CTA), không chỉ bọc riêng nút trigger — cùng khuôn mẫu `relative` wrapper + `Popover` mà `UserMenuTrigger`/`AccountPopover` đã dùng cho menu tài khoản, mở rộng để an toàn ở mọi breakpoint.

knowledge_updates.summary: Adds a durable gotcha for anyone capturing full-page/full-height screenshots of pages that use the prototype's `.reveal` scroll pattern or apps/public-web/components/common/reveal.tsx: a non-scrolling headless capture leaves below-fold content invisible (opacity:0) even when the capture height covers the whole document, because the reveal is IntersectionObserver-driven and the observer's root never grows past the emulated viewport. MEMORIES-0009 review cycle 2 hit exactly this — captureBeyondViewport screenshots were full document height but blank below the hero — and fixed it by emulating `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, which both the prototype and `Reveal` already treat as an immediate-visible fallback (no source change required). Recording this so the next task doing similar CDP/Playwright fidelity capture work on this app does not repeat the mistake.
knowledge_updates.content:
## Ghi chú: capture full-page cho trang có scroll-reveal (`.reveal` / `Reveal`)

Các trang dùng pattern scroll-reveal của prototype (`.reveal` + `IntersectionObserver`, xem `prototype/*/*.html`) hoặc component `apps/public-web/components/common/reveal.tsx` (`Reveal`) sẽ giữ phần tử ở `opacity:0` cho tới khi `IntersectionObserver` báo phần tử đã vào viewport. Khi capture screenshot full-page bằng headless Chrome CDP (`Page.captureScreenshot` với `captureBeyondViewport:true`, clip height = `document.scrollHeight`) mà KHÔNG cuộn trang, `IntersectionObserver` root vẫn chỉ là viewport đã set (vd. 900px cao) — mọi phần tử `.reveal`/`Reveal` nằm dưới đó sẽ không bao giờ intersect, nên ảnh chụp full-height vẫn có nội dung/section bị trống (blank band) dù chiều cao ảnh đúng bằng toàn bộ trang.

Cách khắc phục đã kiểm chứng (không cần sửa source): trước khi `Page.navigate`, gọi CDP `Emulation.setEmulatedMedia({features: [{name: 'prefers-reduced-motion', value: 'reduce'}]})`. Cả prototype (`@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}`) lẫn `Reveal` (tắt hẳn `IntersectionObserver`, không bao giờ áp class `opacity-0`) đã coi `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` là fallback hiển thị ngay lập tức — đây là hành vi có sẵn, không phải hack riêng cho capture. Kỹ thuật này cho ảnh cùng-viewport, không cần cuộn, và tái lập được (xem `ai/tasks/MEMORIES-0009/evidence/fidelity-matrix.json` method_notes cho ví dụ đầy đủ).
